feed.title: Awesome DSH Plugin — Curated DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Plugin List

entry.title: Luaphes/dsh-web-attention-badge

entry.title: zhu1090093659/dsh-web-ui

entry.title: jiangnanquan/dsh-ux

entry.title: a903067276-rgb/dsh-file-mentions
entry.summary: Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.

entry.title: KinGao294/dsh-skin
entry.summary: Codex-style skin switcher plus a custom wallpaper layer with opacity and blur controls.

entry.title: Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale
entry.summary: Whale-girl skin series for the DSH Web UI (maid-atelier).

entry.title: Chinesezjc/dsh-interconnect
entry.summary: Cross-instance message and event handoff between DSH instances via an interconnect server.

entry.title: Wine-Red/dsh-prompt-stash
